items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: So George Stone had died, and the dago had took it over.

ctx.x: What was the name of that club?
The Backbiters Club. So George Stone had died, and the dago had took it over. I suppose he was workin' for them in the first place.
Is that the way it worked during Prohibition? They would bring in the whiskey just a pitcher at a time?
